description: Permissive OSS licenses approved for Native American Tours. Any copyleft license (GPL/LGPL/AGPL/EPL/SSPL) trips the release gate and requires legal review. MPL-2.0 is weak-copyleft and allowed for linking (modifications to MPL files must be re-published). tour-backend runs server-side only and is not distributed, so LGPL/GPL deps may be exempted for documentation purposes; see manualOverrides.

manualOverrides._doc: Manual license attestations and exemptions. Three modes: (1) 'license' only: attests to a license when metadata is missing or wrong. (2) 'exempt: true' + 'license' + 'exemptUntil' + 'reason': keeps the dep in notices but bypasses the allowlist gate. (3) 'exclude: true' + 'reason': removes the dep from notices entirely. tour-backend runs server-side only and is never distributed, so LGPL/GPL terms do not attach; exemptions below document intentionally tolerated copyleft deps.

dompdf/dompdf@*.reason: dompdf is LGPL-2.1. Server-side only PDF generation; not distributed. Revisit if tour-backend is ever shipped as a binary or on-prem.

milon/barcode@*.reason: milon/barcode is LGPL-3.0. Server-side only barcode generation; not distributed. Revisit if tour-backend is ever shipped as a binary or on-prem.

phenx/php-font-lib@*.reason: Transitive dep of dompdf. LGPL-2.1-or-later. Server-side only; not distributed.

phenx/php-svg-lib@*.reason: Transitive dep of dompdf. LGPL-3.0-or-later. Server-side only; not distributed.
